# Rapier

> A self-contained Markdown, text, and code editor. One HTML artifact exposes
> the same semantic operation kernel to its visible UI, WebMCP, and embed hosts.

## Start

- [Open Rapier](https://rapier.website/): The editor and live WebMCP surface in a capable browser.
- [Artifact](https://rapier.website/rapier.html): The complete core editor; no build step, bundler, backend, or network fetch is needed to start and use it. Optional Math and DOCX export bundles are fetched only when requested.
- [Working demo](https://rapier.website/?demo=1): Rapier opened on its included demonstration document.
- [Agent guide](https://rapier.website/agents): Current tools, bounded editing workflow, and document-law conduct.

## Will

- [Will specification](https://rapier.website/WILL-1.md): Will lets a document carry its person's durable intent and the `edit`, `append`, or `keep` law for each governed region.
- [Will vectors](https://rapier.website/VECTORS.md): Portable, machine-judgeable conformance cases.

## Integration

- [WebMCP record](https://rapier.website/WEBMCP-CHALLENGE.md): What the browser-agent projection adds and what remains in Rapier's pre-existing kernel.
- [README](https://rapier.website/README.md): Product, security, network, deployment, and platform contract.

## Evidence

- [Release receipt](https://rapier.website/qualification/RECEIPT.json): Machine-readable identity and one honest status per release gate.
